## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `forge fmt --check` (when Solidity is changed)
- [ ] `forge build` and `forge test -vv` (when contracts are changed)

## Review checklist

- [ ] Documentation and demo/live status are accurate.
- [ ] No secrets, wallet credentials, keystores, or `.env` files are included.
- [ ] No deployment or broadcast was triggered by CI.
- [ ] Security and user-impact implications are described.
